name: Uberduck
summary: An AI voice platform that enables users to create custom voiceovers and songs using a variety of AI-generated voices.
description:
An AI voice platform that enables users to create custom voiceovers and songs using a variety of AI-generated voices.

Make Music, Voiceovers and Videos With AI Vocals, Text to Speech, Voice Conversion and Voice Cloning

Text-to-Speech & Singing: Converts text into speech, singing, or rapping. Voice Cloning: Creates custom voices for various applications. API Access: Provides developers with tools for integration. Music Studio: A platform for creating complete songs using AI vocals.
